subject.title: [Bug]: mimo-v2.5 / mimo-v2.5-pro thinking content leaked into text reply causing severe repetition

question: Should this public MiMo hidden-reasoning exposure proceed as a normal provider-owned Xiaomi bugfix after redacted live proof, or should repair wait for security handling first?
rationale: The source-level fix shape is bounded, but the impact is hidden reasoning exposed to end users and the prior PR was explicitly closed pending owner/security decision.

options.title: Approve provider-owned public repair
options.body: Treat this as a public P1 Xiaomi provider/runtime bug, require targeted tests plus redacted live MiMo proof, and avoid broad SDK/core rewrites unless provider ownership cannot cover custom routes.

options.title: Route through security first
options.body: Pause repair work until a security owner decides whether hidden-reasoning exposure needs private handling, disclosure controls, or a narrower public statement.

options.title: Fold into broader reasoning policy
options.body: Keep this issue open but make the canonical fix part of a broader reasoning-field visibility and channel-delivery design, accepting a slower path for the specific MiMo bug.

recommendation.title: Approve provider-owned public repair
recommendation.body: Treat this as a public P1 Xiaomi provider/runtime bug, require targeted tests plus redacted live MiMo proof, and avoid broad SDK/core rewrites unless provider ownership cannot cover custom routes.
